name: Plaza El Segundo
summary: Plaza El Segundo is a contemporary open-air lifestyle center featuring mid- to upmarket stores, diverse dining options including al fresco experiences, and essential services. Located on Pacific Coast Highway in El Segundo, this modern shopping destination serves the South Bay community with quality retail and restaurant offerings.
demographics: Plaza El Segundo attracts an affluent, professional demographic primarily consisting of young professionals and families aged 25-54 with above-average household incomes, drawn from the surrounding El Segundo and South Bay communities. The trade area includes aerospace industry employees, tech workers, and beach community residents who value convenience and quality dining options. Visitors typically engage in a mix of shopping, dining, and service-oriented visits, with strong weekday lunch traffic from nearby office parks and weekend family shopping patterns.
description: Plaza El Segundo is a contemporary lifestyle shopping center located at 700 Pacific Coast Highway in the heart of El Segundo, California. This open-air destination seamlessly blends mid- to upmarket retail stores with an impressive selection of restaurants and essential services, creating a vibrant community gathering place for South Bay residents and visitors. The center features al fresco dining experiences and modern amenities that cater to the area's professional workforce and families seeking quality shopping and dining options. With convenient hours Monday through Saturday from 10am to 9pm and Sundays from 11am to 7pm, Plaza El Segundo offers accessibility and flexibility for busy lifestyles. The center has established itself as a premier destination in the South Bay area, combining the convenience of neighborhood shopping with the sophistication of carefully curated tenants, including the recently opened SAUCED BBQ and Love.Life, demonstrating ongoing investment in fresh dining concepts and retail experiences.
